0xF6

Description
Rte_Rips_DsmqSwitch notifies the RTE Implementation Plug-In about an enqueue operation in
a distributed shared mode queue.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋
[SWS_Rte_70103]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00315
⌈The Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In assigned to the
distributed shared mode queue shall provide the Rte_Rips_DsmqSwitch
Service for each mode machine instance belonging to this distributed
shared mode queue.⌋
